verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page documents native charts and combined visualizations on live data. Its example metrics cover pipeline (weighted pipeline, pipeline by region, stuck deals) and conversion (win rate, sales cycle, stage conversion), so no spreadsheet export is needed. However, activity reporting is not explicitly documented, 'Advanced reporting' appears as a pricing-tier line item, and all evidence is marketing copy. missing for 10: explicit activity-level reporting (calls/emails/meetings metrics), clarity on which reporting features are tier-gated, in-depth first-party reporting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Analyze live data any way you like, from line charts and bar graphs to geospatial mapping.
Combine visualizations to instantly understand the full story and make better business decisions.
